name: Claspcrown
description: Open the day's rolls with a straight jab from the lead sai at the level of the opponent's belt.

name: Wristvow
description: Circle both sai before the chest in the first roll of the court and stop any cut that enters.

name: Silken Hiltpoint
description: Tread forward on the court's fixed pattern of paces so every step leaves the sai ready.

name: Thrall Sidehook
description: Catch a blade between the forks of both sai and hold it for a single breath of qi.

name: Faithful Crossprong
description: Roll the sai over one another and turn a flurry of cuts out to the sides.

name: Pinionverdict
description: Answer a parry with a return thrust from the second sai along the first one's line.

name: Subjugating Clasp
description: Sink the fork low beneath the blade like a low sun beneath cloud and bind the weapon to the ground.

name: Illustrious Handknob
description: Raise both sai and cross them down onto the opponent's shoulders in a shearing stroke.

name: Twistodyssey
description: Burst from the court's edge in a flash and land both prongs on the guard before it forms.

name: Harmonious Pinion Triumph
description: The court's full roll of nine strokes passes between the two sai and turns each answer into the next opening.

name: Wristedict
description: Open with the sai crossed at the wrists and snap them apart into two quick jabs.

name: Sacrosanct Sanguard
description: Turn the head with the guard so the sai follow the eyes to whichever side the blow comes.

name: Veegrace
description: Cross the feet on a slant as the sai cross above them and arrive on the opponent's flank.

name: Unbending Wrest
description: Cross the sai like scissors round a blade in flight and clamp it where the tines meet.

name: Devout Tineright
description: Parry with the sai crossed and then fly them apart so the cut is thrown off in both directions.

name: Snagdecree
description: Swing the butt-knob from the far end of a crossing and land it on the temple.

name: Peal Pinion
description: Wheel the sai in opposite directions round a weapon and draw it from the hand.

name: Ruling Prongbase
description: Fall on a weapon arm with the sai crossed over it and pin it to the ground.

name: Steel Centerprong
description: Pass the sai through one another in mid-thrust so both prongs reach the same joint of armor.

name: Prism Tinecrook
description: Cross the sai against a mighty blow and throw its force back along the line it came.

name: Symphonic Ensnare
description: The school's signature pass where both sai fly past each other to catch and strike in one unbroken arc.

name: Vaunted Hiltpoint
description: Let the lead sai drift into a soft jab that lands with the full weight of the step behind it.

name: Prismvee
description: Give back an inch with the crossbar as a cut lands so its force sinks into the arm.

name: Squall Sanguard
description: Step in a small circle like an eddy at a rock and leave the attack to pass behind.

name: Pinionedict
description: Tap the butt-knob onto the knuckles like a pebble dropped into still water.

name: Authoritative Snag
description: Take a blade into the fork slowly so it never feels the pull until it cannot move.

name: Venerable Tineleft
description: Wear down a cut by sliding it along the tines the way water smooths a stone.

name: Prongedict
description: Let the opponent's push pass and send the prong back after it like a returning wave.

name: Despotic Twist
description: Draw the tines backward in one soft movement and take the weapon from the loosened hand.

name: Gloom Clasp
description: Press down gently with both sai until the opponent's arm sinks like silt to the basin floor.

name: Heroic Crossprong
description: Spread a single blow into three at the instant of contact so the guard cannot cover all three.

name: Sigil Handknob
description: Meet a technique with perfect stillness at the fork and let its force dissolve like a ripple.

name: Immaculate Eclipse Sidehook
description: The school's gentle answer that yields to any blow and then sends the whole of its force back to the sender.

name: Revered Prongbase
description: Hold both sai raised and apart like folded wings above the shoulders.

name: Snagbanner
description: Lower the body into a stoop and jab both prongs forward from the crouch.

name: Evanescent Handknob
description: Glide down a slope of footing with the sai trailing behind like pinions.

name: Wrestseal
description: Fall onto a raised weapon and catch it in the forks before the arm can come down.

name: Intrepid Sanguard
description: Drop both butt-knobs onto the collarbone together in a short heavy hammer blow.

name: Peal Tinecrook
description: Beat a low cut upward with both tines and open the way for a descent.

name: Masterful Pinion
description: Descend on the opponent's guard arm with both sai and pin it flat to the opponent's chest.

name: Triumphant Sidehook
description: Descend with both prongs on one spot of a breastplate until the plate splits.

name: Harbinger Crossprong
description: Fall with both prongs on one marked spot and send the field through every layer above it.

name: Majestic Pulsar Wrest
description: The codex's own descent in which both sai fall in unison onto the single point the court has chosen.

name: Prongcrown
description: Begin the orbit with a jab from one sai while the other circles back behind the wrist.

name: Undaunted Centerprong
description: Revolve the tines about the wrist so a stream of cuts meets metal at every angle.

name: Windborne Tineleft
description: Pivot along the inner track of the orbit and bring the rear sai forward.

name: Millstone Pinion
description: Catch a blade on one orbiting fork and carry it round with the turn of the field.

name: Magnificent Prongbase
description: Send the orbiting prong inward along a curve that avoids the opponent's parry.

name: Stately Handknob
description: Shed an attack by spinning the sai about each other so its force flies off tangent.

name: Imperious Ensnare
description: Turn the orbit against a weapon's swing and strip it from the hand.

name: Inferno Clasp
description: Swing the orbit wide so the field around the sai strikes everything within the circle.

name: Snagseal
description: Cast the field round the orbit until a weapon drifts in and locks against the tines.

name: Pulsarsnag
description: Fold the whole orbit into a point and vanish to appear at the far side of the opponent.

name: Season Tinecrook
description: The school's complete orbit in which each sai guards while the other strikes and the roles keep trading.

name: Twistverdict
description: Jab from the high position with the long view of the whole court behind the point.

name: Inviolate Sidehook
description: Hold the guard with the Core's steady output flowing evenly through both sai.

name: Twilit Crossprong
description: Step on the line the hawk's long view has already chosen and meet no obstacle.

name: Clasptriumph
description: Rap the butt-knob down from a high angle onto the exposed back of the neck.

name: Peremptory Tinecrook
description: Spread the sai wide and close them on a blade like a hawk closing its talons.

name: Parityvee
description: Bank the sai at an angle to a cut as a hawk banks on a thermal and ride the force out.

name: Splendid Hiltpoint
description: Thrust down at a steep angle so the prong passes over a raised guard.

name: Nucleus Prongbase
description: Sweep the Core's perception across the whole space and mark every hand lifting a weapon.

name: Tyrannous Sidehook
description: Hold a whole weapon arm still beneath the weight of the Core's field through both sai.

name: Quenched Handknob
description: Stoop from the top of a leap and drive both prongs through plate with the Core behind them.

name: Seasonwrist
description: Cross the whole court in a flash and appear above the opponent with both prongs lowered.

name: Exalted Vacuum Pinion
description: The canon's final stoop where the whole court's long view narrows to one drop of both sai.

name: Prongtriumph
description: Jab from a stance sworn at the high edge where a student first learns to hold ground.

name: Enshrined Tineleft
description: Face the wind with both tines raised and let the push settle in the knees.

name: Soundless Prongbase
description: Lean into the wind and step on the push so the whole body rides it forward.

name: Rending Snag
description: Hold the footing at the edge while the fork takes a blade and keeps it against the wind.

name: Twistbanner
description: Rap the butt-knob out at the top of a gust of cuts when the opponent's guard rises.

name: Unwavering Hiltpoint
description: Slip the tines along a blade as a gale slips round a rock and send the cut aside.

name: Royal Centerprong
description: Lunge along a line fixed by oath and let nothing turn the prong from it.

name: Volition Clasp
description: Pin a weapon to the ground with the fork and hold the pin against every attempt to lift it.

name: Wristverdict
description: Drive the prong from the edge of the stance with the whole push of the wind behind it.

name: Interstice Sidehook
description: Vanish on a gust from the high edge and land where the opponent's guard is thinnest.

name: Steel Prongbase
description: The school's sworn stand in which the sai hold a line against every blow until the oath is done.

name: Lordly Tinecrook
description: Jab from a planted stance with the fork held low and the centre prong pointed up.

name: Undefiled Handknob
description: Stand with the tines raised and let a cut break against them without moving the feet.

name: Prongboon
description: Step off the line of an attack and plant again before the next one arrives.

name: Commanding Sidehook
description: Take a blade into the fork without moving the rooted feet and wrench it round.

name: Wristdecree
description: Rap the knob in the still moment after a gust of cuts when the arm is spent.

name: Sainted Crossprong
description: Split a driving thrust against the centre prong and send it past on both sides.

name: Tyrannous Wrest
description: Lever the fork against a hilt and twist until the weapon turns out of the hand.

name: Pinionbanner
description: Counter an attacker's rush from a stand and drive the prong in as the rush ends.

name: Vacuum Sanguard
description: Remain unmoved as a technique arrives and let the fork unmake the force as it passes.

name: Stately Tineright
description: The school's standing guard where the fork remains planted and every attack breaks over it in turn.

name: Pinioncrown
description: Take the bearing on the opponent and jab along it without a hand's breadth of drift.

name: Devout Sidehook
description: Hold the crossbar on its heading so a chopping blow lands square on the tines.

name: Feather Tinecrook
description: Shift a quarter of the compass in one step and change the bearing without losing the sai.

name: Twistcrown
description: Rap the forked yoke against the hand guard to open the fingers a little.

name: Ruling Snag
description: Close the catching fork on a blade and set it fast along the held bearing.

name: Squall Tineright
description: Sweep the tines sideways across the line of a thrust like a gust from the flank.

name: Paramount Hiltpoint
description: Return along the bearing of an attack and drive the prong into its source.

name: Masterful Twist
description: Wrench the caught weapon along the same heading until the hand gives it up.

name: Authoritative Clasp
description: Hold a weapon in the catching fork against a gale of tugs until the arm shakes.

name: Wrestdecree
description: Thrust along the held heading through a gale of cuts and land the prong cleanly.

name: Statute Pinion
description: Seal a caught blade in the fork so its energy cannot answer the wielder's call.

name: Imperious Handknob
description: The school's heading hold where the fork keeps one bearing against every pull until the attacker tires.

name: Wrestbanner
description: Jab across the direction of the opponent's push so the prong comes in sideways.

name: Undaunted Hiltpoint
description: Turn the crossbar edge-on to a cut so the force parts and spills round it.

name: Ethereal Sidehook
description: Slide along the oath edge of the opponent's reach and close from the unguarded side.

name: Peremptory Pinion
description: Cross the sai at a blade's edge as a gust crosses a ridge and clamp it between them.

name: Unrivaled Crossprong
description: Cut the central prong through the gap between two guards and out the far side.

name: Consecrated Centerprong
description: Lash the tines across a stream of cuts like a whip of wind and strip their force.

name: Despotic Clasp
description: Hook a tine under the hilt and lift the weapon from the hand along the cross line.

name: Millstone Sidehook
description: Cross the prong back and forth at a fixed pace until the opponent can only back away.

name: Prism Handknob
description: Break through the far side of a guard with the prong after crossing the wind of its cut.

name: Twistvoyage
description: Vanish across the wind of an attack and arrive at the oath edge of the opponent's guard.

name: Storied Sidehook Edict
description: The school's own thrust across the wind in which the prong crosses an attack and lands beyond it.

name: Wresttriumph
description: Jab out of an open stance with the whole width of the sky behind the arm.

name: Venerable Crossprong
description: Wrap the field around centre prong and tines until a cut finds only a sphere of metal and air.

name: Wraithlike Handknob
description: Slide across the footing as clouds slide across the sky and close without a sound.

name: Unbending Pinion
description: Wrap the field around a weapon the tines have caught and hold it where it is.

name: Immaculate Hiltpoint
description: Throw a wide parry with the tines and let the field push the cut off into the open air.

name: Prongdecree
description: Stretch the field along the centre prong into a lance that reaches past a short guard.

name: Choral Hiltpoint
description: Strike with centre prong and left tine and right tine in turn and swear each stroke to its own line.

name: Sigilsnag
description: Cast the field about the three prongs in a cage that holds a weapon motionless in the air.

name: Tempestuous Clasp
description: Break the open air with all three prongs and a long field that scatters those in front.

name: Grand Tineleft
description: The school's three-prong chain where each prong keeps its own oath and the sky takes the finishing stroke.

name: Majestic Handknob
description: Jab from the far end of the stance with a Core's full steadiness behind the shoulder.

name: Inviolate Tinecrook
description: Hold the guard on a wide bearing so the sai cover far more than the body.

name: Skyborne Tineright
description: Take a long step on a far bearing and arrive at the opponent's side before the turn.

name: Claspverdict
description: Strike with the butt-knob on the line the Core has sworn to hold.

name: Millstone Wrest
description: Catch a weapon from a long way off with the widened tines and draw it in.

name: Faithful Hiltpoint
description: Parry a stroke before it arrives with a gust thrown ahead from the tines.

name: Snagedict
description: Pierce along a long line with the field following the prong for the full length.

name: Magnanimous Prongbase
description: Read the whole plateau of the fight from one steady point and mark each hand that moves.

name: Imperious Twist
description: Press the widened field down on a group of weapons so none can rise.

name: Thunderclap Sidehook
description: Carry the prong along a far bearing in one lunge that pierces whatever stands on the line.

name: Wrestodyssey
description: Cross the plateau's width in a flash with the sai already set for the opening stroke.

name: Dauntless Magma Pinion
description: The codex's sworn stroke that carries the prongs and the field across the whole width of the plateau.
